title: 有 — to have
explanation: 有 means "have/possess" or "there is/are." Negation is 没有 (never 不有). It never takes 了 for completion.
structure:
Subj + 有 + Noun          (possession)
有 + Noun                   (existence: "there is/are")

examples.english: He doesn't have a younger sister.

notes: Negation is always 没有 (méi yǒu), never 不有. 有 does not combine with 了. For "have done," use Verb + 了, not 有 + Verb.
